receipt.public_excerpt: DeepSeek-R1 achieves performance comparable to OpenAI-o1-1217 on reasoning tasks.

evidence_items.explanation: The developer's technical report supports the narrower claim of an o1-class reasoning competitor. It does not establish equivalent capabilities across OpenAI's complete model range.

evidence_items.locator: Section R1-Zero removes the human bottleneck; comparison table and following discussion
evidence_items.explanation: The table reports R1 at 15.8% and $0.06 per task, versus o1 at 20.5%, 31%, and 35% with higher compute settings and costs. This documents a real price advantage alongside a capability gap on this test, challenging broad interchangeability without resolving the full model-range claim.

unresolved_gaps: The cited evaluations do not cover nearly all OpenAI offerings or practical capabilities.
No comprehensive matching-period evaluation of R1 1776 was obtained.
A single benchmark cannot establish how important remaining differences were across customer uses.
No supplied threshold determines when competition becomes almost complete commoditization.
